articles.title: Xi wraps up US visit with Trump meeting expected soon
bullets: AP reported Xi ended his US visit with a Constitution-focused stop.
The visit followed high-level Trump-Xi talks in Washington.
Trade, AI and Iran tensions framed the diplomacy.

articles.title: New Mexico jury finds Facebook liable in privacy case
bullets: AP reported a New Mexico jury found Facebook liable.
The case involved allegations about deceiving users on privacy protections.
The verdict adds to Meta’s US legal scrutiny.

articles.title: US diesel-export ban talk shakes energy markets
bullets: Reuters reported Washington’s diesel-export ban talk widened crude-price spreads.
Markets read the move as potentially reducing US refinery runs.
The issue emerged amid elevated Middle East energy uncertainty.

articles.title: US business activity hits more than five-year high
bullets: Reuters said S&P Global’s flash US Composite PMI rose to 58.4.
New orders drove the strongest activity since July 2021.
Price pressures increased as demand strained supply chains.

articles.title: Dollar dips as oil eases and yen rebounds
bullets: Reuters reported the dollar fell Friday after four sessions of gains.
Oil prices dropped more than 2%, reducing safe-haven pressure.
The yen rallied after Japan reiterated its intervention stance.

articles.title: US moves to secure remaining Ukraine aid before fiscal deadline
bullets: Reuters reported the administration planned to lock in remaining USAI funds.
About $307 million of $400 million had already been obligated.
The fiscal-year deadline falls on September 30.

articles.title: Oil slides as US and Iran explore path out of war
bullets: Reuters reported oil fell about 2% on Friday.
Traders weighed a possible US-Iran truce against supply risks.
Middle East uncertainty remained central to commodity pricing.

articles.title: Trump confirms planned November meeting with Xi in China
bullets: APA listed Trump confirming a China meeting with Xi in November.
The update followed Xi’s state visit to the United States.
Iran and the Strait of Hormuz were among discussed issues.

articles.title: Russian attacks on Kyiv reported to kill seven and injure dozens
bullets: APA listed seven killed in Russian attacks on Kyiv.
The reported injury count rose to 57.
The update came late on September 25.

articles.title: EU weighs Ukraine-support risks after French and German elections
bullets: APA listed reports of EU concern over Ukraine support.
The concern followed French and German election results.
The issue reflects uncertainty over Europe’s future aid posture.

articles.title: India orders captive coal plants to maximize output
bullets: Reuters reported India ordered over 100 captive coal plants to run fully.
The directive applies from October 1 through year-end.
Officials cited expected growth in electricity demand.

articles.title: India rebukes Pakistan after Shehbaz Sharif’s UN speech
bullets: Hindustan Times reported India warned Pakistan at the UN.
Indian officials accused Pakistan of duplicity after Sharif’s remarks.
The exchange came during UN General Assembly diplomacy.

articles.title: Maharashtra declares 265 talukas drought-affected
bullets: Hindustan Times reported Maharashtra classified 265 of 358 talukas drought-hit.
The declaration followed rainfall and crop-stress assessments.
Relief measures are expected to follow state procedures.

articles.title: Heavy showers damage crops in parts of Uttar Pradesh
bullets: Hindustan Times reported crop damage after heavy UP showers.
IMD forecast thunderstorms and more rain in affected areas.
The weather raised concerns for farmers before harvest.

articles.title: Explosion reported at suspected illegal firecracker unit in Bihar
bullets: Hindustan Times reported an explosion in Bihar’s Araria district.
Police suspected an illegal firecracker unit was involved.
Authorities were investigating the blast circumstances.

articles.title: Microsoft rallies after new Copilot capabilities
bullets: Reuters reported Microsoft rose 3.7% on Friday.
The company unveiled new Copilot features, including coding tools.
Its move helped lift the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.

articles.title: Qualcomm gains as investors buy AI-linked stocks
bullets: Reuters reported Qualcomm gained 4% Friday.
AI-related technology shares led market strength.
The move came during a volatile week for AI beneficiaries.

articles.title: Dell advances amid renewed AI infrastructure demand
bullets: Reuters reported Dell advanced 5% Friday.
Investors favored companies tied to AI infrastructure spending.
The rally accompanied gains in other tech hardware names.

articles.title: Akamai jumps after Anthropic cloud-services deal
bullets: Reuters reported Akamai Technologies rallied 3.2%.
The move followed an $11.6 billion cloud-services deal with Anthropic.
The agreement includes a warrant for up to 5% of Akamai.

articles.title: Bloom Energy leads large-cap gainers in market-mover data
bullets: Sirius Investors showed Bloom Energy up 8.27%.
The stock topped its large-cap gainer list early September 26.
The page tracked S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow components.

articles.title: Banco BPM shares rise on Credit Agricole-Anima report
bullets: Reuters reported Banco BPM shares rose after a deal report.
The report involved Credit Agricole and Anima.
The move reflected renewed European banking-sector deal speculation.

articles.title: Poste falls short of Telecom Italia delisting threshold
bullets: Reuters reported Poste missed the Telecom Italia delisting threshold.
The update followed shareholder tender results.
The outcome complicated the planned ownership restructuring.

articles.title: Eaton to acquire Italy’s COL Group
bullets: Reuters reported Eaton agreed to buy grid-equipment maker COL Group.
The deal expands Eaton’s electrical infrastructure footprint in Italy.
Financial terms were not shown in the roundup snippet.

articles.title: Volkswagen has no current Italy plant plans, minister says
bullets: Reuters reported Italy’s industry minister commented on Volkswagen plans.
The minister said VW had no current plans for Italy.
The update came amid European auto-sector pressure.

articles.title: Pinewood Technologies shareholders approve $721 million deal
bullets: Reuters reported Pinewood Technologies shareholders approved a $721 million transaction.
The approval was listed among late September 25 corporate updates.
The company operates in automotive retail technology.

articles.title: Microsoft unveils new Copilot tools and always-on AI agent
bullets: Reuters reported Microsoft introduced several Copilot app capabilities.
New features included a coding tool and always-on AI agent.
The announcement helped lift Microsoft shares Friday.

articles.title: Anthropic signs $11.6 billion Akamai cloud-services deal
bullets: Reuters reported Anthropic agreed to a major Akamai cloud deal.
The deal includes a warrant for up to 5% of Akamai.
Akamai shares rallied after the announcement.

articles.title: EU vote on Tesla supervised self-driving system delayed
bullets: Reuters reported an EU vote on Tesla’s system was pushed back.
The issue concerns Tesla’s supervised self-driving technology.
Regulatory approval remains central to Tesla’s European rollout.

articles.title: Anthropic blocks possible AI bioweapons attempt
bullets: BBC listed Anthropic blocking a possible misuse attempt.
The incident involved AI assistance related to biological weapons.
The disclosure appeared in Anthropic threat-intelligence reporting.

articles.title: US and China discuss AI incident alert mechanism
bullets: AP reported US officials proposed an AI incident notification system.
The proposal was raised in talks before Trump-Xi meetings.
Officials framed it around national-security risks.
